headline: 格伦·史密斯离开农业信贷管理局，转任农业部副部长
summary: 美国农业信贷管理局2026年8月24日宣布格伦·史密斯离任，转任美国农业部主管农村发展的副部长，并结束农业信贷系统保险公司理事会主席职务。农业部公告确认，他已于8月21日宣誓就任新职；两项原职务的具体离任日期未公布。

sources.title: Glen Smith departs FCA to serve as under secretary for rural development at USDA
sources.excerpt: Today, the Farm Credit Administration announced the departure of Board Member Glen Smith following his Senate confirmation as under secretary for rural development for the U.S. Department of Agriculture.

sources.title: Glen Smith departs FCA to serve as under secretary for rural development at USDA
sources.excerpt: Following Smith’s departure, the FCA and FCSIC boards will each have one remaining member.

sources.title: Glen Smith Sworn in as Under Secretary for Rural Development
sources.excerpt: (Washington, D.C., Aug. 21, 2026) – U.S. Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins officially swore in Glen R. Smith of Atlantic, Iowa, as U.S. Department of Agriculture Under Secretary for Rural Development.
